page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.m1 server family. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. It is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per physical core.

The ecs.m1.medium instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It contains no GPU accelerators. Hardware-level instruction set extensions such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-assisted cryptography (AES, SHA) are not supported on this instance type.

Because the CPU allocation is dedicated rather than shared, the instance delivers stable and predictable compute performance. This resource profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring consistent CPU execution without the pricing premium of memory-optimized or compute-optimized tiers. The balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance suitable for general-purpose workloads, including mid-tier web servers, application hosting, and lightweight database instances that do not require local storage or specialized hardware acceleration.
